In detail

No coverage of robbery, drug activity, or violent incidents was found for Valverde. The only locally-specific hit concerned repairing physical disrepair in the old Fuencarral village area, an infrastructure issue rather than crime. Sources checked: Decide Madrid participatory debate (infrastructure, not crime); Consejo de Seguridad Fuencarral-El Pardo minutes.

Frequently asked questions

Is Valverde safe?

Wandroz currently rates Valverde in Madrid as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Madrid during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Madrid at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Madrid publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Valverde safe at night?

At night, Valverde is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Madrid. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Valverde a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Valverde's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Madrid) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.

Is there official crime data for Valverde?

Not an official government crime feed — Valverde's rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used). An absence of recent negative coverage is treated as inconclusive, not as proof the area is safe. If you live in or know Valverde well, you can suggest a correction using the link below.
